text: on-transition ExecutableEntity A RunnableEntity or a BswSchedulableEntity that is triggered by a SwcModeSwitchEvent respectively a BswModeSwitchEvent with ModeActivationKind ‘transition’ is triggered on a transition between the two specified modes. It is called on-transition ExecutableEntity. See also section 4.4.1.

targets.why: on-transition ExecutableEntity execution during mode switch
